costCategory.description: Cost Category. LEAVE BLANK unless the user names a specific Cost Category (e.g. Crop Insurance). Do NOT default to 'N/A' (it is a real exact-match value; sending it unrequested can wrongly return no results). Pass 'N/A' ONLY when the user explicitly means the N/A bucket.

department.description: Department. LEAVE BLANK unless the user names a specific Department. Do NOT default to 'N/A' (it is a real exact-match value; sending it unrequested can wrongly return no results). Pass 'N/A' ONLY when the user explicitly means the N/A bucket.

opportunityName.title: Opportunity Name
opportunityName.description: A grant name to trace forward to the Budget Lines it funds. Leave blank to trace a Budget Line scope instead.

subUnit.title: Sub Unit
subUnit.description: Sub-Unit. LEAVE BLANK unless the user names a specific Sub-Unit. Do NOT default to 'N/A' — 'N/A' is a real, exact-match value here, so sending it when the user didn't ask for it filters the scope down to only lines whose Sub-Unit is literally N/A and can wrongly return no results. Pass 'N/A' ONLY when the user explicitly means the N/A bucket.
